# IoT Fabrikken

> IoT Fabrikken builds wireless IoT sensor networks for indoor climate
> analysis, preservation, space optimisation (meeting-room and desk occupancy
> analytics) and water-leak detection. The RoomAlyzer platform delivers
> real-time data, dashboards, alarms and open integrations (MQTT, REST,
> Azure IoT Hub, OS2iot, Dalux, Pronestor, Power BI, BMS/CTS).
> We serve schools, offices, hospitals, museums, churches, archives,
> municipalities, hotels, retail, warehouses and elderly care across Europe.

Key facts:

- Company: IoT Fabrikken (Denmark). Platform: RoomAlyzer.
- Sensor catalogue in four lines: RoomAlyzer Air (CO2, Full+, Humidity, Mini+,
  Mini+ PIR, Outdoor, Temperature), RoomAlyzer Space (Desk, Motion, Open/Close,
  Touch), RoomAlyzer Water (Water detector, Water rope) and Miscellaneous
  (Cloud connector, Range Extender and Bracket).
- Site languages: English (/en/), Danish (/da/), German (/de/), Swedish (/sv/).
  English is the canonical source; the root URL redirects to /da/.

This file lists only pages that are currently published. Other sections
(platform, pricing, ROI, library, integrations) are not live yet and are
intentionally omitted. English links first; key Danish pages at the end.

## Modules

- [Modules overview](https://iot-fabrikken.com/en/modules/)
- [Indoor climate](https://iot-fabrikken.com/en/modules/indoor-climate/) — CO₂, temperature, humidity, VOC for schools, offices, hospitals.
- [Preservation](https://iot-fabrikken.com/en/modules/preservation/) — protect collections, archives, churches and manors from humidity and temperature swings.
- [Space management](https://iot-fabrikken.com/en/modules/space-management/) — meeting-room occupancy, desk sharing, floor utilisation.
- [Water detection](https://iot-fabrikken.com/en/modules/water-detection/) — stop leaks before they spread; insurance-grade documentation.
- [Push buttons](https://iot-fabrikken.com/en/modules/push-buttons/) — one-tap service calls for cleaning, maintenance, restock.
- [Lockers & doors](https://iot-fabrikken.com/en/modules/lockers-doors/) — wireless open/close monitoring.
- [Usage & cleaning](https://iot-fabrikken.com/en/modules/usage-cleaning/) — demand-based cleaning driven by real occupancy.
